rationale: Ahmad brings deep hardware expertise from Vision Pro and Leap Motion in spatial computing and computer vision, while Tuan is building AI-powered geospatial intelligence for solar energy adoption — both are applying computer vision and ML to hardware-software integration challenges. Ahmad's conviction around AI-native hardware deeply integrated with generative models and Tuan's background architecting at scale could inform how climate tech hardware evolves beyond software-first approaches.
intro_message: Ahmad Abbas, meet Tuan Van Doan — you both work at the intersection of computer vision, AI, and hardware systems, and could exchange perspectives on integrating ML models with physical infrastructure at scale.
